    The main results from the dichotomy node alone #

    ScalarNode is proved (MildContours/Basic/ExcAssembly.lean), so BGRS multiplicative bases hold (mulBasisNode_of_scalar). Bongartz's Theorem 6, Theorem A and both corollaries now depend only on DichotomyNode (the dichotomy on the universal cover).
